server.name: DataPulse MY
server.description: Read-only access to DataPulse MY's Malaysian public dataset catalogue (389 datasets, 8-status health taxonomy, licence/attribution metadata).

auth.note: All tools are read-only; no auth needed. Rate limiting via Cloudflare Tunnel free tier.

tools.name: search_datasets
tools.description: Search DataPulse MY's 389 Malaysian public datasets by natural-language query. Filter by licence (e.g. 'CC BY 4.0', 'Open Government Licence (Malaysia)') or source ('OpenDOSM', 'data.gov.my', 'MET Malaysia', etc.). Returns ranked matches: id, title, source, licence, status, score. Use when an agent needs to find datasets covering a topic, by an agency, or under a specific licence.

query.description: Free-text search terms; natural language is allowed, e.g. 'inflation cpi'.

licence.description: Optional exact licence name or supported alias, e.g. 'CC BY 4.0'.

limit.description: Maximum ranked matches to return; integer from 1 to 50, e.g. 10.

tools.name: get_dataset
tools.description: Return full detail for one dataset id, including its latest health status and last-verified timestamp, content_freshness_date, and freshness_signal_source (last_modified, content_parse, or none). Use to fetch the provenance/citation metadata for a dataset found via search_datasets and distinguish unknown-freshness from proven stale data.

dataset_id.description: Canonical dataset identifier, e.g. 'dosm_cpi_state'. See the registry catalogue for valid IDs.

tools.name: find_stale
tools.description: Return datasets whose status is aging, stale, or degraded, plus datasets missing from the latest health snapshot. Use when an agent needs to know which data has a freshness or schema-validity risk.

max_age_hours.description: Maximum acceptable age of the latest health check in whole hours; non-negative integer, e.g. 72.

tools.name: get_provenance
tools.description: Return citation-ready provenance metadata for the listed dataset ids: source steward, licence (with URL), source URL, access method (curl/Camofox), last-verified timestamp. Use when an agent needs to cite DataPulse MY data in a response and must include proper attribution and licence.

dataset_ids.description: JSON array of 1 to 50 canonical dataset IDs, e.g. ['fuelprice', 'pricecatcher'].

tools.name: find_by_licence
tools.description: Return all datasets with the given licence, summarised. Use to enumerate what's available under a specific licence for compliance/reuse scoping.

licence.description: Exact licence name or supported alias, e.g. 'Creative Commons Attribution 4.0'.

resources.name: Dataset index
resources.description: Lightweight list of all 389 datasets with namespace. Read this first.

resources.name: Licence summary
resources.description: Counts of datasets by licence, computed from the current manifest.

resources.name: Full manifest entry
resources.description: Full schema, source URL, attribution, and current health for one dataset.

rate_limits.note: Cloudflare Tunnel free tier; no per-IP limit published. Be a good citizen.
